title: UI风格#114 - Art Nouveau Botanical (新艺术植物)
description: 创建第114种UI风格：新艺术植物风格 - 百合花、葡萄藤、细腻线条、自然之美。输出到 G:/claude_code_project/web/index_planDJ.html

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Art Nouveau Botanical style When color palette Then features sage green, muted gold, ivory cream, burgundy, lavender
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 需要设计：#8FBC8F (灰绿), #C5A572 (暗金), #FFFFF0 (象牙), #800020 (酒红), #B76E79 (淡紫)

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Art Nouveau Botanical style When typography Then uses elegant fonts: Cormorant, Lora, or Britannic
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 字体选择：Cormorant (标题), Lora (正文), Britannic (装饰)

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Art Nouveau Botanical style When layout Then botanical illustrations, vine borders, lily ponds, garden paths
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 布局特点：植物插画、藤蔓边框、百合池塘、花园小径

acceptance_criteria.evidence: 交互特点：押花纹理、水彩晕染、墨水插画、藤蔓生长

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Art Nouveau Botanical UI When functional Then includes botanical chat, gardener agents, bloom stats
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 功能需求：植物聊天、园丁代理、绽放统计
